summary: Reorder the rows and columns of M into a block upper triangular matrix with diagonal blocks A and A*, where A is paddedLeading(j, Z(γ⁻¹)) with its top row replaced by that of Z(γ⁻¹); then [det M] = |N(det A)|². For j = ϱ + 1, A = Z(γ⁻¹) and |N(det A)| = N^{2f}minorNorm by definition; for j ≤ ϱ, Cramer's rule with the shared frame vector of γ⁻¹ at the top gives det A = (unit)·N·D_j, so again |N(det A)| = N^{2f}·minorNorm(S, j, γ).

steps.claim: Introduce the lets; A = paddedLeading(j, Z(γ⁻¹)) (rows a < j of Z(γ⁻¹), identity rows elsewhere) with the top row replaced by the top row of Z(γ⁻¹).
steps.lean:
intro r _ _ _ _ P M; let A :=
    (paddedLeading j (S.frameProducts γ⁻¹)).updateRow 𝔰.top (S.frameProducts γ⁻¹ 𝔰.top)

steps.claim: [det M] = |N_{E/ℚ}(det M)| (det M is rational), and it suffices that |N(det A)| = N^{2f}·minorNorm(S, j, γ) (a side goal, steps 3–9) together with |N(det M)| = |N(det A)|²:
steps.lean:
erw [← RingHom.map_det, ← (?_ : |↑(Algebra.norm ℚ A.det)| = _ * _)]
  · let g := finSuccEquivLast.trans (r.symm.optionCongr.trans (optionEquivSumPUnit _))
    have d := M.det_reindex_self ((sumAssoc ..).symm.trans (((sumAssoc ..).sumCongr
      (.refl _)).trans (sumSumSumComm ..))) ▸ det_permute (sumComm ..) _
    rw [(Matrix.ext (Sum.rec (Function.swap (Sum.rec ?_ fun _ _ ↦ by rfl)) ?_) : submatrix _ _ _ =
      fromBlocks (reindex g g A) (of _) 0 (reindex g g Aᴴ))] at d
    · simpa [sq] using congr(|(Algebra.norm ℚ $d.symm : ℝ)|)
    all_goals simp +zetaDelta [splitGram, middleGram, frameGram, apply_ite star]; grind

steps.claim: g: the reindexing of the frame indices (finSuccEquivLast, r, Option ≃ Sum) used for A;
d: det M equals the determinant of M with its index sum reassociated and the two halves swapped (det_reindex_self, det_permute);
that reindexed matrix is fromBlocks(A', *, 0, A'*) with A' = A reindexed by g (checked entrywise),
steps.lean:
rw [(Matrix.ext (Sum.rec (Function.swap (Sum.rec ?_ fun _ _ ↦ by rfl)) ?_) : submatrix _ _ _ =
      fromBlocks (reindex g g A) (of _) 0 (reindex g g Aᴴ))] at d

steps.claim: so |N(det M)| = |N(det A)·N(conj det A)| = |N(det A)|²;
the entrywise identities: the Gram entries of the columns f_a, γf_a, e*_a, z, γz under the split Gram matrix (splitGram, middleGram, frameGram; grind).
steps.lean: all_goals simp +zetaDelta [splitGram, middleGram, frameGram, apply_ite star]; grind

steps.claim: Cases j = ϱ + 1 and j = j' ≤ ϱ (Fin.lastCases):
steps.lean:
cases' j using lastCases with j
  · simp [show A = S.frameProducts γ⁻¹ by simp [A, ← ext_iff], minorNorm, field]
  choose w e using h.inv.exists_shared_frame_vector j.le_last
  erw [← cramer_transpose_apply, ← det_smul_inv_vecMul_eq_cramer_transpose _ _
    (by simpa [↓det_paddedLeading] using h.inv.2.1),
    Pi.smul_apply, congr($det_paddedLeading • $(frameProducts_mulVec_of_frameImage_eq e) _)]
  obtain ⟨⟩ := (congr(‖Φ · $(star_mul_last_eq_of_frameImage_eq
    e)‖)), congr(diag $h.inv.paddedLeading_mul_inv 𝔰.top)
  simp_all [tsub_eq_zero_of_le, ← sq, minorNorm, ← conjTranspose_submatrix, j.le_last.not_gt]; ring

steps.claim: j = ϱ + 1: A = Z(γ⁻¹) (step 5) and the identity is the definition of minorNorm with (j − ϱ)₊ = 1 (field_simp).
steps.lean: · simp [show A = S.frameProducts γ⁻¹ by simp [A, ← ext_iff], minorNorm, field]

steps.claim: A = Z(γ⁻¹): at j = last, paddedLeading keeps all rows below the top, and the top row is replaced by itself.
steps.lean: show A = S.frameProducts γ⁻¹ by simp [A, ← ext_iff], minorNorm, field]

steps.claim: j ≤ ϱ: the shared frame vector of γ⁻¹ (level j by HasLevel.inv): frameImage(1)·w = frameImage(γ⁻¹)·(top column of paddedLeading(j, Z(γ⁻¹))⁻¹).
steps.lean:
choose w e using h.inv.exists_shared_frame_vector j.le_last
  erw [← cramer_transpose_apply, ← det_smul_inv_vecMul_eq_cramer_transpose _ _
    (by simpa [↓det_paddedLeading] using h.inv.2.1),
    Pi.smul_apply, congr($det_paddedLeading • $(frameProducts_mulVec_of_frameImage_eq e) _)]
  obtain ⟨⟩ := (congr(‖Φ · $(star_mul_last_eq_of_frameImage_eq
    e)‖)), congr(diag $h.inv.paddedLeading_mul_inv 𝔰.top)
  simp_all [tsub_eq_zero_of_le, ← sq, minorNorm, ← conjTranspose_submatrix, j.le_last.not_gt]; ring

steps.claim: Cramer's rule: det A times the top column of A⁻¹ is the top column of the adjugate, and Z(γ⁻¹) applied to that column is −N·w_top·e_top (frameProducts_mulVec_of_frameImage_eq), with det paddedLeading = D_j(γ⁻¹) ≠ 0;
steps.lean:
erw [← cramer_transpose_apply, ← det_smul_inv_vecMul_eq_cramer_transpose _ _
    (by simpa [↓det_paddedLeading] using h.inv.2.1),
    Pi.smul_apply, congr($det_paddedLeading • $(frameProducts_mulVec_of_frameImage_eq e) _)]

steps.claim: |w_top| equals the modulus of the top coordinate of the column (star_mul_last_eq_of_frameImage_eq), and the top diagonal entry of paddedLeading·inverse is 1;
combining, |N(det A)| = N^{2f}·|N(D_j(γ))| (the conjugate transpose has the same minors) = N^{2f}·minorNorm(S, j, γ) as (j − ϱ)₊ = 0 (simp_all; ring).
steps.lean: simp_all [tsub_eq_zero_of_le, ← sq, minorNorm, ← conjTranspose_submatrix, j.le_last.not_gt]; ring
